title: Platform Service Offering to Business Customers: Strategic Considerations in Engendering Seller Use of Marketing Tools
authors: Botao Yang; Sha Yang; Shantanu Dutta
eligible_reason: Structural cognitive-hierarchy (level-k) model of 2,686 sellers' monthly choice among four options (no tool, search ad, hot shop, both) on an e-commerce platform over six months (April-September), estimated by simulated ML with a reduced-form demand side. Tool use is a month-by-month multinomial choice modeled structurally, not a staggered binary treatment; no DiD or event study.
design_notes: recover parameters/platform_L4_syn.m maximizes sellerL4.m (likelihood over choice indicators I0-I3 by month given seller grade, buyer grade and log assortment); simulate data/simulate_syn.m regenerates choices from the model. Regression inventory empty (MATLAB only).
data_files_note: README: data under NDA; noise added to seller/buyer characteristics, monthly sales simulated from the raw-data distribution, seller choices simulated from the model.
data_provenance_note: Characteristics disguised with noise; sales and tool choices regenerated by simulation (README).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
